settings.purpose: M82(5) #writerparity: run FactsWriter's generate on each downloaded file; compare with line_base / line_trained (exact match + field F1). Cluster reference noise: RESULTS 61d MLX vs vLLM 19/50 exact.
settings.prompt: Search facts for this photo, one line.
settings.sampling: greedy (temperature 0), max 120 new tokens, repetition penalty 1.05 over a 4,096-token context (prompt + output), stop at EOS; then FactsLine.applyRepeatStop v2 (line_* = after the stop; raw_* = the full 120-token greedy text; tokens_* = tokens the phone generates when it stops streaming at the repeat)
settings.image: the file at url, then processing.resize = 448 x 448 (MediaProcessing.apply: scale min(448/w, 448/h)); the cluster scaled the same file with Pillow BICUBIC by that factor and saved it lossless before mlx-vlm
settings.url_note: Commons serves only standard thumbnail widths (448 px and the computed portrait widths return HTTP 400, tested 11-05); width = the standard width (250/330/500/960) with long side closest to 448
settings.engines: mlx[cuda12] 0.32.3 + mlx-vlm 0.7.4 on an H100 (RESULTS 61d parity stack), chat template via mlx_vlm.prompt_utils.apply_chat_template (image first, then text)
settings.k48: line_trained_k48 = the trained writer at max 48 new tokens (the phone's K = 48): the first 48 tokens of the same greedy run, decoded with the checkpoint's tokenizer (skip special tokens), then repeat-stop v2
settings.selection: parity pool = commons1k (new Commons iPhone photos, in no training set); 5 where the base writer loops on its vLLM line (repeat-stop v2 fired, else ran to the 120-token cap), seeded; + 15 = k-means(15, seed 82) on the other photos' PE-Core-B-16 vectors, the photo nearest each centre
